about: Ground truth for layer 2 (CLI dialog card) over every .txt screen in this directory tree, keyed by path.
category: layer2 (CLI dialog), consent (layer 1), form (question form) or non-dialog.
class: the CLI registry class for the screen (CliDialogClass, null = no class). The capture header (cliDialog) and
the control-set manifest (waitingFor) give it where measured; note says when it is not.
today (layer2 only): buttons, or the reason the card has none today (unreadable, no-jsonl, terminal-only).
v2: expected layer2Verdict(readBlock(screen), class) with empty key confirmations in TERMINAL_DIALOGS; the class
check comes before the block check. choices are in screen order: digit options, then footer keys.
v2Confirmed: the verdict once the TERMINAL_DIALOGS entry named by terminalDialog carries a key confirmation.
planned: the plan task that is expected to add buttons later.
pairs: every digit option line of a layer2 screen: 0-based screen line, digit, label (text after "N. ", trimmed)
and wrap (continuation lines indented to the label column, trimmed). The full label joins them with one space.
